newsitem.title: SPAIN: Peseta draws on dollar strength to firm.
newsitem.headline: Peseta draws on dollar strength to firm.

text.p: The peseta firmed slightly on Tuesday against the mark, benefitting from a stronger dollar driving many European currencies higher against the German currency.
"Given the dollar's new strength, the mark has weakened against most of the European crosses although to a smaller degree against the peseta," a dealer said.
The peseta could firm to 84.40 per mark, trading at 0735 GMT at 84.45/47 after 84.50/52 earlier today and late Monday's 84.50/53.
The dollar rose to its highest levels in the last 40 months to reach 1.7488 marks, before slipping to 1.7450/60.
